title: WPMS/2594/2018 of Anil Jetli Vs Chief Engineer World Bank r and B U.d.r.p. Dehradun AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.2594 of 2018
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. A.K. Sharma, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Additional CSC for
the State/respondents.
 Petitioner who is a contractor had
constructed the "puliya" for the respondent
authorities, however, the same was washed out
in the monsoons. Since in the contract, there is a
clause that in case any damage is caused to the
"puliya" within two years, the contractor shall
repair/reconstruct the same. However, since the
petitioner did not repair/reconstruct the
"puliya", his security money was withheld by
the respondents.
 Earlier the writ petition of the petitioner
being WPMS No.2002 of 2018 was disposed of
by this Court with the direction to decide the
representation of the petitioner.
 Now the petitioner has again filed this writ
petition alleging that without deciding his
representation, the respondent authorities have
invited tenders and accordingly he has
challenged the tender notice dated 23.07.2018.
 Considering that tender notice has already
been issued and also considering that the
aforesaid damaged "puliya" needs urgent repair,
this Court finds no ground to interfere in the
present matter.
 Consequently, the writ petition is dismissed
in limine.
